{{Quote|We have given ourselves over to the dark side.''"<br>"''We have pieced together the secrets of the Sith&hellip;''"<br>"''And gathered  knowledge forbidden to all but two.|The dark side adherents to Darth Vader|<ref name="Resurrection" />}}
Three [[Human/Legends|Human]] '''dark side adherents''' operated on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Kalakar Six]]. They claimed to have uncovered secret knowledge of the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] that was otherwise only known to [[Galactic Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]] and his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|Sith Apprentice]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. The adherents believed that a remnant of the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] remained within Vader from his time as the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Anakin Skywalker, and so they sought to eliminate him<ref name="Resurrection" /> by either resurrecting, [[Cloning/Legends|cloning]] or conjuring a vision<ref name="Chee">{{Blog|holocron|22/comments|Movie Characters killed in the EU}}</ref> of Palpatine's former apprentice [[Darth Maul/Legends|Darth Maul]].

In [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> the adherents lured Vader to Kalakar Six through false information regarding the recently stolen [[Death Star plans/Legends|plans]] for the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[DS-1 Orbital Battle Station/Legends|Death Star]]. Vader traveled to the moon, where the adherents and Maul dispatched his [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]]. Inside a [[Unidentified fortress|fortress]], the adherents revealed themselves and challenged Vader's loyalty to the Sith. Maul [[Duel on Kalakar Six|duelled]] Vader and lost when the latter [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] impaled himself with his own [[Darth Vader's lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] to kill Maul. The adherents were shocked at their loss, and were then killed by Palpatine, who had abruptly arrived.<ref name="Resurrection" />
